title: Apache Syncope: SQL injection via unsanitized opEvent in Audit Events search
description:
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in Apache Syncope.



This CVE covers an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-77051: an administrator with adequate entitlements can achieve execution of arbitrary SQL via stacked queries, leveraging unsanitized opEvent parameters.
Reference: https://cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77051

This issue affects Apache Syncope: from 3.0.0-M0 through 3.0.16, from 4.0.0-M0 through 4.0.8, from 4.1.0-M0 through 4.1.3.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.0.9 / 4.1.4, which fix this issue.
cwe: CWE-89 CWE-89 Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection')

title: Contact Form 7 6.2 - 6.2.3 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload via Invalid UTF-8 Filename
description: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files uploaded through a form file field, and a flaw in its temporary-file cleanup leaves the uploaded file on disk, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files to the site. On a stock Debian or Ubuntu Apache configuration, which lists directory contents and maps .phar to the PHP handler, the stored file can be located and executed, leading to Remote Code Execution. On other configurations, including nginx and Apache with .htaccess overrides enabled, the issue is limited to an arbitrary file written into the uploads directory, which may still be served as active content such as HTML or SVG from the site's own origin.
cwe: CWE-434 Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CWE-434 CWE-434 Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

title: Apache HertzBeat: incomplete XPath expression validation in aliasFields
description: Apache HertzBeat versions 1.7.1, 1.7.2, 1.7.3, 1.8.0, and 1.9.0 have incomplete XPath expression validation in the HTTP collector XML parsing path. An authenticated user with permission to create monitor templates can supply XPath expressions through metrics.aliasFields that are evaluated without the validation applied to parseScript. When processing a crafted XML response, repeated evaluation may consume excessive CPU resources and impair collector availability. This is a follow-up to the incomplete fix for CVE-2026-24343. The fix is included in Apache HertzBeat 1.9.1. Users should upgrade to 1.9.1 or a later version.
cwe: CWE-643 CWE-643

title: Apache ZooKeeper: Unbounded recursion in snapshot serialization allows a client to render the server unrecoverable
description:
Uncontrolled recursion in Apache ZooKeeper. The server serializes its data tree to a snapshot by recursing one stack frame per znode level, with no depth bound. A client permitted to create znodes (the default root ACL is open) can build a chain of nested znodes deep enough that taking a snapshot exhausts the JVM stack and kills the snapshot thread; sizes stay within jute.maxbuffer, so existing limits do not prevent it. This is a denial of service that becomes persistent: on restart the server rebuilds the deep tree from its transaction log and fails again while taking the startup snapshot, so it does not return to service, and recovery can entail data loss. The same log affects a leader and its followers, so it can spread across an ensemble.

This issue affects Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.0 through 3.8.7 and 3.9.0 through 3.9.6. Users are recommended to upgrade to 3.8.8 or 3.9.7, which fix the issue. As a workaround, use ACLs and authentication to restrict znode creation rather than relying on the default open root ACL.
cwe: CWE-770 CWE-770 Allocation of resources without limits or throttling
credits: Sai Sreewathsa Kovalluri, Shon Babu, and Kannan K of Innspark Solutions (https://innspark.in/)
Prasath Jayasundar & PayPal Cyber Security Team

title: Apache Kafka: Connect Admin REST API Authentication Bypass via Unapplied REST Extensions
description:
Apache Kafka Connect contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the admin REST API when admin.listeners is configured with a separate listener from the main listeners property.

When operators isolate the admin REST API by explicitly configuring the "admin.listeners" property, REST extensions specified via rest.extension.classes (such as BasicAuthSecurityRestExtension) are not registered or applied to the admin resource configuration.

While the primary REST API listener (configured via listeners) enforces configured authentication and authorization filters, endpoints mounted under the separate admin listener (/admin/loggers) fail to inherit or instantiate these extension filters. As a result, the admin logger endpoint accepts unauthenticated read and write requests even when security extensions are active on the main listener.

Impact:

An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the admin listener can:

  1. Read the complete set of logger names and levels, disclosing loaded class names and which security extensions are in use.
  2. Write logger levels, including with scope=cluster which propagates the change to all workers in the Connect cluster. This can be used to suppress
     logging (setting root to OFF) or generate excessive log output (setting root to TRACE), potentially impacting availability and observability.

Mitigation:

  Users who cannot upgrade immediately can remove the admin.listeners configuration (or leave it unset). When unset, admin resources share the regular listener and inherit its security extensions.

Resolution:


From Apache Kafka 4.2.2, 4.3.2, and 4.4.0, we make sure the REST extensions specified via "rest.extension.classes" will also apply to "admin.listeners".
cwe: CWE-288 CWE-288 Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel

title: Apache Vysper: Unbounded allocation
description:
**UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED**  Unbounded allocation in XML parsing in Apache Vysper; all versions, may lead to an out of memory condition.




This issue affects all versions of Apache Vysper. Apache Vysper is an XMPP (Jabber) server library.




As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative.
cwe: cwe-770
CWE-770 CWE-770 Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

title: Apache Vysper: Authorization bypass
description:
**UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED**  Authorization bypass in Apache Vysper, all versions.




Apache Vysper is an XMPP (Jabber) server library. Its XEP-0077 (In-Band Registration) implementation is missing an authentication check, allowing any authenticated user to compromise other accounts.




As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative.
cwe: CWE-639 CWE-639 Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key

title: Apache Qpid Proton C: Verifying non compliant TLS wildcard cert can cause stack buffer overflow read
description:
A misconfigured wildcard TLS certificate causes a stack read overflow.



This issue does not affect any wildcard certificate issued to the RFC9525 standard - the fix only accepts certificates that comply to this standard.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-125 CWE-125 Out-of-bounds read

title: Apache Kafka: Kafka Connect configuration provider values exposed via validation REST API endpoint
description:
Apache Kafka Connect has the /connector-plugins/{connector-type}/config/validate endpoint on its REST API to validate connector configurations.
Apache Kafka Connect also support Configuration Providers which enable to hide the values of sensitive configuration and only resolve them at runtime. 

An attacker with access to the validate endpoint can use it to resolve and return plaintext values via any of the configuration providers installed on a Connect worker.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.2.2, 4.3.2, 4.4.0 or above, which fix this issue.
cwe: CWE-200 CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Apache Allura: OAuth1 rebinding
description:
OAuth 1 rebinding vulnerability in Apache Allura.



This issue affects Apache Allura: through 1.22.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.22.1, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-863 CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

title: Apache Roller: Exposure of other users' email addresses through the user search
description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to learn other users' email addresses. The user search in the authoring interface shows only user names, but it also matched the search text against email addresses, so a user could confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which matches only user names for users who are not administrators.
cwe: CWE-200 CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Apache Roller: Unpublished entries of other weblogs readable through preview
description: Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to read unpublished entries of a weblog they have no role in. The entry preview checked that the user was logged in, but not that the user had a role in the weblog being previewed. The attacker must know the weblog name and the entry's link name. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires a role in the weblog to preview its entries.
cwe: CWE-862 CWE-862: Missing Authorization

title: Apache Roller: Commenter email addresses recoverable through public search
description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to recover the email addresses of people who left approved comments. The search index stored commenter email addresses, and the public weblog search accepted queries on that field, including wildcard queries that confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later and rebuild the search index.
cwe: CWE-200 CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Apache Roller: Unpublished entries remain readable through search after AtomPub unpublish
description: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to read an entry after its author has withdrawn it to draft through the AtomPub API. The entry was removed from the weblog but stayed in the search index, and public search showed its content. AtomPub is disabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which shows only published entries in search results.
cwe: CWE-668 CWE-668: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

title: Apache Roller: Cross-site request forgery through GET requests to administrative actions
description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Apache Roller 5.0.1 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated attacker to create an administrator account if a logged-in Roller administrator opens a link that the attacker controls. The request-token check applied only to POST requests, and administrative actions also accepted GET requests. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires POST and a valid token for actions that change data.
cwe: CWE-352 CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

title: Apache Roller: Disabled accounts can sign in through OpenID
description: Improper Authentication in Apache Roller 5.1.0 through 6.1.6 allows a user whose account an administrator has disabled to sign in again through OpenID and read unpublished entries. The OpenID sign-in path did not check whether the account was enabled. Only sites that enable the non-default OpenID authentication mode are affected; later major versions do not include OpenID 2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.
cwe: CWE-287 CWE-287: Improper Authentication

title: Apache Roller: Stored cross-site scripting through imported blogroll links
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's visitors. Blogroll links imported from an OPML file were not checked, and the default theme printed them without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which accepts only web links on import and escapes them on output.
cwe: CWE-79 CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: Apache Roller: Stored cross-site scripting through the weblog description
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 6.1.2 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's members when they open their main menu. The HTML-stripping routine kept a tag that was not closed, and the main menu printed the weblog description without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.
cwe: CWE-79 CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: Apache MINA: Unsafe Deserialization (CWE-502) in JavaNativeMessageDecoder
description:
**UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED** 

JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, so an
application that puts it in front of an untrusted peer is open to gadget-chain RCE.

As the 3.0.0 branch is inactive, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. 

Users are recommended to use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.X branch.
cwe: CWE-502 Unsafe Deserialization (CWE-502) in JavaNativeMessageDecoder

title: Apache Commons Codec: Blake3 doFinalize is stateless; the documented KDF example derives identical keys
description:
Apache Commons Codec's Blake3 class documented the output of its doFinalize methods as depending on any previously finalized bytes, so that consecutive calls would return different output. In fact, doFinalize does not change the hash state: calling it again without supplying more input returns the same bytes. The key-derivation example in the class Javadoc, shipped since 1.16.0, derives two keys with two consecutive doFinalize calls. Code that follows it gets identical keys, so the separation between the derived keys is lost. The same applies to any application that calls doFinalize more than once on one instance and expects new output each time.



This issue affects Apache Commons Codec from 1.16.0 before 1.23.0.



Version 1.23.0 corrects the documentation, but the behavior of doFinalize is unchanged. Upgrading alone does not fix affected code. Users should check their applications for repeated doFinalize calls on the same Blake3 instance and derive multiple keys by requesting the combined length in one call and splitting the output, as the updated Javadoc shows.
cwe: CWE-684 CWE-684 Incorrect Provision of Specified Functionality
CWE-1068 CWE-1068 Inconsistency Between Implementation and Documented Design

title: Gravity Forms < 3.2.2 - Unauthenticated LFI via Chunked File Upload
description: The Gravity Forms WordPress plugin before 3.2.2 does not properly restrict the file types that unauthenticated users can upload through its chunked file upload feature, allowing them to read server environment variables and the contents of files within the web root on servers configured to parse Server-Side Include documents, such as Apache with SSI enabled.
cwe: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
CWE-22 CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

title: Apache HTTP Server: mod_http2: heap corruption and RCE in assign_headers
description:
Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE.

This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70.
Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
cwe: CWE-362 CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
credits: Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-MAPKT6MZ
Anthony Weems and Simon Scannell of the Google Cloud Vulnerability Research

title: Apache Oozie: workflow rerun bypasses the per-job ACL and reassigns ownership
description:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper input validation vulnerability in Apache Oozie. An authenticated Oozie user can reconfigure another tenant's
workflow job and change its ownership.



This issue affects Apache Oozie: all versions.



As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative or restrict access to the instance to trusted users.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.
cwe: CWE-20 CWE-20 Improper input validation

title: Apache JClouds: XML External Entity (XXE) in provider-response parsing
description:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper restriction of recursive entity references in DTDs ('XML entity expansion') vulnerability in Apache JClouds.



This issue affects Apache JClouds: all versions.



As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative or restrict access to the instance to trusted users.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.
cwe: CWE-776 CWE-776 Improper restriction of recursive entity references in DTDs ('XML entity expansion')

title: Apache Thrift: Java TProtocolUtil.skip() does not limit the recursion depth by default
description:
Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache Thrift Java bindings.



This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.24.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.24.0, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-674 CWE-674 Uncontrolled Recursion
credits: Yu Bao – yubao@paypal.com, who works for paypal.com

title: Apache Axis2/Java: unbounded JSON request body buffering
description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. The JSON message builders, including the Gson, Moshi and HTTP/2 variants, buffered the entire request body with no size limit, so an unauthenticated caller could exhaust server memory with a large JSON request. Version 2.0.2 bounds JSON request bodies with the configurable jsonMaxRequestSize parameter. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-770 CWE-770 Allocation of resources without limits or throttling

title: Apache Axis2/Java: XML External Entity (XXE) injection via imported WSDL/XSD documents
description: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. When a client built an AxisService from a WSDL URL, through ServiceClient or AxisService.createClientSideAxisService, wsdl4j import resolution was enabled and the documents named by wsdl:import and xsd:import were parsed by wsdl4j's own XML parser, which processes DOCTYPE declarations and external entities. An attacker who controls a WSDL, or a document it imports, could therefore read local files or make the JVM issue network requests. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-611 CWE-611 Improper restriction of XML external entity reference

title: Apache Axis2/Java: SSRF via WSDL/XSD schema import resolution
description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. When Axis2 built a service description from a WSDL, through ServiceClient, AxisService.createClientSideAxisService or WSDLToAxisServiceBuilder, it fetched the absolute URLs in wsdl:import locations and in xsd:import and xsd:include schemaLocations with no scheme or host restriction; the AAR and WAR deployment resolvers also passed absolute schema locations on to the network. An attacker who controls a WSDL or schema processed by an Axis2 application could therefore make the JVM send requests to arbitrary internal or external hosts. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-918 CWE-918 Server-Side request forgery (SSRF)

title: Apache Juneau: Path traversal in DirectoryResource allows reading files outside the configured root directory
description:
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Apache Juneau.

The microservice DirectoryResource does not keep request paths inside its configured root directory. When an application enables the resource's view, upload or delete settings (all off by default), a client can read, write or delete files outside the root, anywhere the server process has access.

This issue affects Apache Juneau: through 9.2.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.1, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-22 CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

title: Apache DataSketches Java: Uncontrolled resource consumption when deserializing crafted sketch images
description:
Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability in the sketch deserialization of Apache DataSketches Java.



Several deserializers trusted sizes and counts declared in the serialized input. A small crafted input could make an application allocate an excessive amount of memory, leading to an OutOfMemoryError. A crafted string passed to FrequentLongsSketch.getInstance(String) could also make deserialization, or a later update, loop indefinitely. Only applications that deserialize sketches from untrusted sources are affected.



This issue affects Apache DataSketches Java: through 9.0.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.1.0, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-400 CWE-400
CWE-789 CWE-789 Memory allocation with excessive size value
CWE-835 CWE-835 Loop with unreachable exit condition ('infinite loop')

title: Apache Roller: Limited weblog members can remove or change published entries
description:
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog member with the Limited role to remove or change entries that member may only read, including entries published by other members. The entry editor checked the member's weblog role but not whether that role permits work on the entry.
Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.
cwe: CWE-862 CWE-862: Missing Authorization

title: Apache Roller: Deserialization of untrusted data in weblog update ping responses
description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Apache Roller. When Roller sends a weblog update ping, its XML-RPC client deserializes Java object data contained in the ping target's response, so a party that controls that response can run code in the Roller server process. This issue affects Apache Roller from 4.0 through 6.1.6. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.1.7, which removes the unsafe deserialization.
cwe: CWE-502 CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

title: Apache Axis2/Java: SSRF via WS-Addressing ReplyTo and FaultTo endpoints
description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. An unauthenticated caller could supply a non-anonymous WS-Addressing wsa:ReplyTo or wsa:FaultTo address, and Axis2 would open a connection to that address to deliver the response or fault, allowing requests to internal hosts and delivery of response content to a host of the caller's choosing. From 2.0.2, decoupled responses are refused unless allowNonAnonymousResponseEndpoints is enabled, and enabled endpoints are restricted by scheme and screened at both the header-parsing and transport-selection layers. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-918 CWE-918 Server-Side request forgery (SSRF)

title: Apache Sling XSS: xssAPI.getStyleToken() accepts markup in unquoted urls.
description:
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in Apache Sling XSS. xssAPI.getStyleToken() accepts markup in unquoted urls.



This issue affects Apache Sling XSS: before 2.4.14.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.14, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting')

title: Apache Axis2/Java: Cross-site scripting in the OpenAPI module's Swagger UI page
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting) vulnerability in the OpenAPI module of Apache Axis2/Java. The Swagger UI page served by the OpenAPI module wrote a value derived from the request's Host header into the page without encoding, allowing script injection in the context of the Axis2 origin. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting')

title: Apache Axis2/Java: Unbounded multipart and form-encoded request bodies
description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. The multipart/form-data and application/x-www-form-urlencoded message builders read the request body directly from the transport stream with no size limit, so the servlet container's post-size limit did not apply, and multipart temporary files were not deleted. An unauthenticated caller could exhaust memory or disk. Version 2.0.2 bounds these bodies with configurable limits and deletes temporary files. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-770 CWE-770 Allocation of resources without limits or throttling

title: Apache Axis2/Java: exposeServiceMetadata not enforced on all metadata routes
description: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing') vulnerability in Apache Axis2/Java. The exposeServiceMetadata service parameter was enforced only on the ?wsdl, ?wsdl2 and ?xsd queries. For a service that had disabled it, the packaged .wsdl and .xsd file routes, the named-WSDL ?wsdl=NAME route of the standalone HTTP server, the OpenAPI, Swagger UI and MCP catalog endpoints, the services listing, WS-MetadataExchange GetMetadata and the ping module still disclosed its metadata to anonymous callers, including operation names and request and response schemas. This issue affects Apache Axis2/Java: through 2.0.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.2, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-425 CWE-425 Direct request ('forced browsing')

title: Apache Axis2/C: Out-of-bounds read in the Guththila XML reader wrapper
description: Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability in the Guththila XML parser wrapper of Apache Axis2/C. On some malformed XML input the Guththila parser returned a raw input byte in place of an event code, and the AXIOM reader wrapper used that value as an index into a ten-entry lookup table without checking its range, reading heap memory past the end of the table. An unauthenticated client could trigger this by sending a crafted XML request to a server built with Guththila, the default parser, causing the request to be parsed incorrectly or, in some cases, the process to crash. The memory read is not returned to the client. This issue affects Apache Axis2/C: through 2.0.0. The fix is available in commits 23110287924e79d05a5b4712298c355d1f05c606 and f01683ec10e8fddb87279ec9351b3239021223e6 and will be included in the next release.
cwe: CWE-125 CWE-125 Out-of-bounds read

title: Apache Commons Codec: NUL bytes in tree entry names cause Git/SWHID identifier collisions (GitIdentifiers class)
description:
The GitIdentifiers class in Apache Commons Codec did not reject NUL bytes in tree entry names. Because Git uses a NUL byte to mark the end of each entry name in a tree object, a crafted name could make one tree serialize to the same bytes as a different tree. Two different directory trees could then receive the same Git tree identifier or SWHID.



The impact is limited: common file systems do not allow NUL bytes in file names, so trees built by walking a file system are not affected. Only applications that build trees from names supplied by other sources, such as entries of archive formats that permit NUL bytes in names (e.g. ZIP) or names passed directly to the API, are exposed.



This issue affects Apache Commons Codec: from 1.22.0 before 1.23.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.23.0, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-158 CWE-158 Improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character

title: Apache Storm: Logviewer follows worker symlinks across topology ACLs
description: When workers run as the topology owner, the Logviewer serves files that a worker has placed in its own log directory as links to other files. A user who is allowed to submit topologies can read the worker logs of other users' topologies, and other files the Logviewer process can read. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.2.0, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-59 CWE-59 Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')

title: Apache Storm: DRPC HTTP doAsUser bypasses the impersonation authorizer
description: The DRPC HTTP endpoint lets an authenticated client act as another user without applying the configured impersonation authorizer. An authenticated user can execute DRPC functions that are restricted to another user. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.2.0, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-863 CWE-863 Incorrect Authorization

title: Apache XML Graphics FOP: Temporary files on Unix-like systems are readable by other local users
description:
Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics FOP.



This issue affects Apache XML Graphics FOP: through 2.11.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.12, which fixes the issue.
cwe: CWE-378 CWE-378 Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
